notes: הֲשַׂמְתָּ לִבְּךָ עַל is read as the contiguous idiom שִׂים לֵב fused into *considered* (rule 30), which leaves the suffix and עַל with no English of their own (rules 22, 40), while the interrogative particle takes the fronted *Hast* (rule 17).
Both indefinite articles of *a perfect and an upright man* are given to אִישׁ as the noun that licenses them (rules 15, 25); the competing distribution onto each attributive is named in that unit.
